name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog and an approved Awin Feed, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.8.7 never infers product condition: searches accept UNKNOWN condition unless the user explicitly requests new, used, refurbished, or open-box. It ranks trusted registry and approved Affiliate Program merchants first, then qualified high-rated Shopify products, then other relevant merchants with a clear trust warning. Risky domains remain excluded. Authorized Chrome remains a bounded fallback after API search returns no usable product. Commercial relationships never affect relevance or ranking. The agent never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Clear shopping request: call matching tool now. No Memory, repo scan, plan narration, or manual MCP launch.
